notes.title: Major Update: [New Coin Pusher] + [Anime-Style Poster Girl] Now Available!
notes.notes:
Apologies for keeping everyone waiting! Thank you all  for your love and support of "Coin Push RPG"![p align="justify"]These two major updates are thanks to your active feedback.
[p align="justify"]Here's a summary of the main new content:
[p align="justify"]1. \[New Coin Pusher Machine] We've decided to release this for FREE! Hope you all enjoy it!
[p align="justify"]2. \[Anime-style Assistant Girl DLC] This is a paid DLC, launchingwith an additional 10% discount! Get an super cute assistant girl for a single-digit price! (Includes 8 interactive actions like head pat, happy, and over 15 lines of Japanese and Chinese voice acting.)
[p align="justify"]Detailed Update Content
[p align="justify"]1. Added the \[Super Lucky Star] New Coin Pusher Machine - Free Update!
[p align="justify"]Players just need to update the base game to experience it!
[p align="justify"]Ps: The "big" coin tower you've all been asking for is here!
[p align="justify"]Rules Explanation:
[p align="justify"]① The turntable spins continuously. When a token lands in a UFO, you receive the reward corresponding to the UFO's color at the current pointer position.
[p align="justify"]② The number and winning color pointed to will light up on the corresponding level of the lighthouse on the left. After a level lights up, you receive the reward.
[p align="justify"]③ When you earn a Lucky Star, the transport chute accumulates one layer of tokens. After accumulating 50 layers, they are instantly generated onto the playfield.
[p align="justify"]④ When the Golden Ball is hit, the turntable starts a lottery draw. If the ball falls into a hole, you get the corresponding reward. (Includes a playfield clearance reward.)



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45106032/c67be6fe915891076a09baee2d9c64592f50dade.gif"]


[p align="justify"]2. Released \[Coin Push RPG - Ruri] DLC
[p align="justify"](This DLC is a "Supporter Pack" for Coin Push RPG. The content is an Assistant Girl skin-type DLC. It contains no numerical values or anything that affects gameplay experience.)
[p align="justify"]DLC Content: Includes 8 interactive actions for the assistant girl (head pat, happy, etc.), and over 15 lines of Japanese and Chinese voice acting.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45106032/918a616dcdfef1b55a090f64fc85a00ca9d63e72.gif"]


[p align="justify"]Introduction:
[p align="justify"]Name: Ruri / 神宮寺 琉璃
[p align="justify"]Gender: Female
[p align="justify"]Height: 165cm
[p align="justify"]Age: 18 (First year at a top private university / Newly elected Student Council President)
[p align="justify"]Background:
[p align="justify"]The sole heir to the Shinguuji conglomerate. Raised with an elite education from childhood, she lives in opulent conditions beyond most people's imagination. Her every move exudes the elegance and grace of a young lady from a prestigious family, recognized in social circles as the "perfect ojō-sama" (young lady). Her academic results consistently top the charts. With impeccable ability and a dignified yet approachable demeanor, she served as student council president in high school and was quickly elected again upon entering a top-tier university. She excels at strategy, coordination, and public speaking, earning the trust of teachers and the admiration of her peers.
[p align="justify"]However, this perfect young lady harbors a huge secret unknown to most—she is utterly obsessed with arcade coin pusher machines! It all started with a rare act of "rebellion" in her childhood when she sneaked into an arcade. She was completely captivated by the dazzling lights of a coin pusher, the clattering sound of coins, and the instant thrill. Since then, beyond high-end salons and private concerts, shabby or trendy arcades have become her "sanctuary" for releasing stress and seeking pure joy.
[p align="justify"]Personality:
[p align="justify"]In Public: The flawless student council president image. Confident, calm, rational, dignified with just the right amount of elegance and reserve. Her speech and conduct are impeccable. She handles affairs decisively and possesses strong leadership skills and a sense of responsibility. She holds herself to extremely high standards, with a slight tendency towards perfectionism and tsundere traits.
[p align="justify"]In Private (Arcade Mode): Once she enters the arcade, it's like a seal has been lifted! Her gaze becomes sharp and focused, her lips curl into an unconscious smile, and she might even show childlike excitement and tension ("Ah! So close! One more coin!").
[p align="justify"]In front of the coin pusher, she's no longer the lofty ojō-sama but a passionate player immersed in the game. She will clench her fist and whisper in triumph for a perfect push, or stomp her foot in frustration at a near miss (though she quickly returns to calm analysis

notes.title: Coin Pusher Hero: Epic Double Update – Sept 9
notes.notes:
Dear players, hello everyone! Thank you for your enthusiastic support and companionship—this has always been the driving force for our development team to keep moving forward. Now, we are pleased to announce that the epic double update will officially launch on September 9th!



【Major Update Content】


Free Major Update — Brand-New Cyber-Themed Coin Pusher
A brand-new cyber-style coin pusher is coming soon, bringing a unique visual experience. Featured elements such as the grand wheel and large coin tower are fully added, along with special reward mechanisms like "Multiplier Moments" and "Coin Tower Arrival," making the coin-pushing process even more exciting.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45106032/b9dcf05a0caab55fecb6ab1580a9707a700aa262.gif"]
New Interactive DLC — Anime-Style Bishoujo Character
A brand-new anime-style bishoujo character is about to debut—she will trigger different reactions based on your coin insertion, and you can unlock interactions like coquetry, cute gestures, and encouragement by clicking. Paired with exclusive voice lines, she will bring a more vivid and companionable coin-pushing experience to coin masters.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45106032/918a616dcdfef1b55a090f64fc85a00ca9d63e72.gif"]

notes.title: First Version Emergency Update Notice - Optimized Coin Exit Issues & More!
notes.notes:
Dear Bilao Community,

Due to the overwhelming response from today's launch, some fixes or replies may have been delayed. We sincerely apologize and thank you for your understanding! Our team has been working tirelessly to optimize and resolve issues—please grant us a little more time!

All feedback has been carefully documented. Based on your input, we’ve implemented the following updates within 24 hours:

[NEW]

Added an auto-clear function for the Pure Coin Push Mode when reaching 1 million points. (Push all the way!)

Added a red flashing alert for expiring contracts.

[OPTIMIZATIONS]

Adjusted the coin exit gaps in Pure Coin Push Mode to prevent "Gold Bricks" and "Diamonds" from falling through (gap height restricted).

Increased speed of the Lottery Wheel.

Resized the auto-costume change and dismissal buttons in Brave Mode.

[BUG FIXES]

Fixed negative values in damage statistics.

Fixed incorrect monster HP recovery.

We’re launching an official strategy contest today to gather high-quality guides. Join our community to participate!

Coin Push Heroes belongs to all Bilao members. We prioritize your feedback and will keep improving—thank you for your patience!

Lastly, we humbly ask for your kindness in Steam reviews! 🙏

Report bugs via Discord: https://discord.com/invite/R6dETkSBp7. 
Issues will be prioritized and resolved ASAP. Thank you for supporting our 2-year passion project—we won’t let you down!

notes.title: Demo Closing Friday – See You in the Full Release!
notes.notes:
A huge thank you for your support. During the demo period, many players have provided us with fantastic suggestions and feedback. 

We truly appreciate all the love and support you’ve shown us. Right now, the development team is fully focused on polishing the game, and we no longer have the capacity to maintain the demo.

As a result, we’ve decided to close the demo this Friday to dedicate all our efforts to developing the official version. We’ll do our best to deliver the best possible experience for all you awesome players!

See you in the official release, everyone!
